purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official Lu'an sources confirm the city registration center, a map-based property-record lookup, and internal data integration. Its documented outputs include parcel maps and protected property/right information, and its endpoint is plain HTTP; no safe geometry-only schema or endpoint was verified.
registryAssessment: The Lu'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau documents a city real-property-registration information visualization service and identifies the Municipal Real Estate Registration Center as its operator/partner. The city describes a public map-based lookup, but its own description says results combine parcel location/map with planning permits, physical property information, and associated rights restrictions. The related service notice calls for disclosure filtering/de-identification. Because no public geometry-only field allowlist was verified, the documented service is not treated as a safe parcel-geometry route.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Lu'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau (2022) says its real-property-registration visualization service offers public map-based lookup and may return parcel location/maps, planning permits, property natural status and related rights restrictions. The page documents a plain-HTTP endpoint; it was not accessed.

The municipal bureau's 2023 update notice describes feeds for parcels, buildings, units, boundary points and parcel-map geometry; it instructs disclosure only after de-identification and sets a frequent update process.
The municipal government lists Lu'an Municipal Real Estate Registration Center and its office address, corroborating the city registry institution.

accessReview.reason: The official bureau's 2022 launch notice documents an online map-based real-property lookup and gives the platform endpoint as plain HTTP; it says the search can return parcel maps, natural-property details, planning-permit information, and associated rights restrictions. The 2023 bureau notice describes integration of parcel, building, household/unit, boundary-point, and parcel-map feeds and says public disclosure is de-identified. No request was made to the HTTP platform because it is not TLS-protected and the published output is not limited to geometry and stable public parcel IDs. No owner, address, property, rights-restriction, or tax lookup was made.

privacy: No owner, address, taxpayer, account, title, protected attribute, or property-record lookup was made. No geometry was retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official documentation confirms the city service exists and indicates city/county data coverage and frequent updates, but does not publish a field allowlist, anonymous feature schema, CRS, or safe endpoint. Its broad record display means it cannot presently qualify as a geometry-only source. The cited release/coverage claims are from 2022–2023 and do not establish current endpoint availability or parcel coverage at the WUP point.
